item.title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station [auto]

item.title: Same Text, Different Prediction: Serving-Context Nondeterminism in Text Classifiers [auto]
item.description: batch shape 变化在 bf16 下可导致高达 56.7 个百分点的概率漂移，即使标签不变也不能保证分数稳定——这对生产环境部署是严肃警告

item.title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression [auto]
item.description: KV缓存压缩会丢失序列后半段（代码补全、字段值等逐字复制任务），KVFetch用时间预取通道弥补这一根本缺陷， verbatim copying 从 0.8 飙升到 78.4，且无需训练、即插即用

item.title: Deep Read: Vision Language Models Are Blind [draft]

item.description: Kouka's signal system: the internet passes through AI first, then my rules decide what deserves attention; 0-8 items a day reach my head.

item.title: Check eight [draft]
item.description: Check eight of eight is the one people skip: write down what you did not test. Then copy it into the limitations section as it is. The checklist is in the Vault, under Checklists.

item.title: The Saturnus Checklist: Eight Things to Check Before You Believe an Experiment [draft]
item.description: An audit checklist for ML experiments. Seeds, config hash, data hash, leakage checks, baseline parity, negative controls, variance across seeds, and the item most often forgotten, what was not tested.

item.title: Missing Is Not Zero: Well-Posed Modality Removal for RGB-D Segmentation [draft]
item.description: What does zero-filling a missing depth input actually measure? A removal-equivalence criterion and what it reveals.

item.title: Deep Read: Visual Chain-of-Thought, or Does the Model Look Again? [draft]
item.description: A close reading of Wu and Xie's V*, which treats guided visual search as a core mechanism of multimodal LLMs. It turns "does the model look again?" from a metaphor into an action that can be designed and tested.

item.title: Engineering Science: Research as Reproducible Engineering [draft]
item.description: Seeds, hashes, append-only logs and falsification gates: a manifesto for doing research as engineering.

item.title: Does Distillation Transmit the Act of Self-Correction, or Only Its Vocabulary [draft]
item.description: An LLM-as-judge audit of 440 traces over 10 CoT distillation datasets: distillation copies the sound of self-correction more easily than the act.

item.title: The Hermes Constellation: Five hIEs and Their Cron [fiction]
item.description: Five agents named after hIEs, scheduled in a crontab: paper deep-reads, signal sweeps, audits, tooling dives, and a weekly digest.

item.title: Failed runs are kept [draft]
item.description: Failed runs are archived, not deleted. Nine failed experiments, eight findings: the archive is in the Vault, under Failed runs.

item.title: Nine Failed Experiments, Eight Findings [draft]
item.description: Diffusion-LLM reasoning and DSpark sequential heads: two closed campaigns, and why failures deserve an archive.

item.title: Evidence Over Eloquence: Let Deterministic Code Adjudicate Truth [draft]
item.description: MingJing's governance philosophy: the LLM proposes, deterministic code adjudicates, and every claim traces back to its source.

item.title: Deep Read: Attention Sinks, and Why Attention Share Is Not Evidence [draft]
item.description: A close reading of Xiao et al.'s StreamingLLM. The first few tokens soak up a large share of attention, not necessarily because they matter. For anyone measuring how much attention a VLM gives to image tokens, this is required reading first.

item.title: Deep Read: Lost in the Middle, How Language Models Use Long Contexts [draft]
item.description: A deep read of Liu et al.'s Lost in the Middle: models do worst when the relevant information sits mid-context. It is a baseline to rule out before claiming visual evidence fades in long reasoning.

item.title: Deep Read: Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning [draft]
item.description: A deep read of Lanham et al. (Anthropic): early answering, adding mistakes, paraphrasing and filler tokens as interventions that test whether an answer really depends on the written reasoning.

item.title: An hIE Is Not a Vessel, It Is a Policy That Earns Trust [draft]
item.description: From Beatless to long-horizon agents: trust is never granted to a single output, only to a policy proven over time.

item.title: Rewriting Shaders: Light, Volumetrics, and Late-Night GLSL [draft]
item.description: Notes on two shader repos: rewriting Complementary and maintaining a BSL enhanced pack, plus why a researcher writes GLSL at night.
